test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Transform the following sentence into active voice.

All the structures built in that area had been demolished due to encroachment.

options.text: They had demolished all the structures build in that area due to encroachment.
They had demolished all the structures that were built in that area due to encroachment.
They had demolished all the structures built in that area due to encroachment.
They had demolished all the structures built in that area due to encroachment by the people.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice sentence.
 
• The given sentence in the passive voice is: "All the structures built in that area had been demolished due to encroachment."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the implied doer of the action, "they," as the subject of the active sentence.
 
• Retain the tense of the verb "had been demolished" as "had demolished" in the active voice.
 
• Ensure clarity by keeping the phrase "due to encroachment" at the end of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They had demolished all the structures built in that area due to encroachment."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"They had demolished all the structures build in that area due to encroachment." – Incorrect verb form "build" instead of "built."
 
• **Option 2: **"They had demolished all the structures that were built in that area due to encroachment." – Correct but unnecessarily wordy.
 
• **Option 4: **"They had demolished all the structures built in that area due to encroachment by the people." – Adds unnecessary information ("by the people") not present in the original sentence.
